title: Functional tumor-reactive CD8 + T cells in pancreatic cancer.
authors: Sun, Hongwei; Shi, Changying; Fang, Guoqing; Guo, Qiufang; Du, Zhengliang; Chen, Geer; Wu, Yasong; Chen, Zhe-Sheng; Hua, Jian; Zhang, Yan; Shi, Zhiwen
journal: Journal of experimental & clinical cancer research : CR
one_liner_zh: 该文用单细胞测序与深度学习识别胰腺癌肿瘤反应性CD8+T细胞，虽涉及转录因子FOS但核心是免疫细胞功能与临床预后，非蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合建模，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Traditional methods for detecting tumor-reactive (TR) CD8 + tumor-infiltrating lymphocytes (TILs) in pancreatic cancer usually focus on neo-antigenic epitopes, which is limited by the narrow range of antigenic epitopes, and the lengthy and complex identification processes, resulting in an incomplete understanding of the biological characteristics of TR CD8 + TILs. METHODS: This study introduces a novel approach that integrates single-cell sequencing with deep learning (DL), which enables the identification of tumor-reactive CD8 + T cells without neoantigen screening. The T Cell Receptor Engineered T (TCR-T) cell tumor organoid killing model was employed to validate the functionality of DL-identified TR CD8 + T cells, while spatial transcriptomics was used to confirm receptor-ligand interactions involving TR CD8 + TILs. RESULTS: Comprehensive analyses of TR CD8 + TILs revealed impaired mitochondrial respiratory chain-related pathways regulated by the transcription factor FOS. The TIGIT-NECTIN2 axis was identified as an important immune checkpoint molecule in the tumor microenvironment of pancreatic cancer. T cell receptor (TCR) repertoire analysis demonstrated that some TR CD8 + TILs possess multiple TCR alphabeta combinations. Furthermore, TCR-T targeting experiments using tumor organoids revealed that combinations of multiple distinct TR TCRs exhibit significantly superior tumor-killing capabilities compared to a single type TCR. Clinically, a higher proportion of TR CD8 + TILs was positively associated with improved responses to neoadjuvant immunotherapy and longer overall survival in pancreatic cancer patients. CONCLUSION: This study represents a significant advancement in the understanding of TR TIL biology and provides a rapid and accurate method to identify TR CD8 TILs.
abstract_zh: 背景：传统检测胰腺癌中肿瘤反应性（TR）CD8+肿瘤浸润淋巴细胞（TILs）的方法通常聚焦于新抗原表位，但受限于抗原表位范围狭窄以及鉴定过程冗长复杂，导致对TR CD8+ TILs生物学特性的理解不完整。方法：本研究引入了一种新方法，将单细胞测序与深度学习（DL）相结合，无需新抗原筛选即可识别肿瘤反应性CD8+ T细胞。采用T细胞受体工程化T（TCR-T）细胞肿瘤类器官杀伤模型验证DL识别的TR CD8+ T细胞的功能，同时利用空间转录组学确认涉及TR CD8+ TILs的受体-配体相互作用。结果：对TR CD8+ TILs的综合分析揭示了由转录因子FOS调控的线粒体呼吸链相关通路受损。TIGIT-NECTIN2轴被确定为胰腺癌肿瘤微环境中的重要免疫检查点分子。T细胞受体（TCR）库分析表明，部分TR CD8+ TILs具有多种TCRαβ组合。此外，使用肿瘤类器官的TCR-T靶向实验显示，多种不同TR TCR的组合相比单一类型TCR表现出显著更优的肿瘤杀伤能力。临床上，较高比例的TR CD8+ TILs与胰腺癌患者对新辅助免疫治疗的改善反应及更长总生存期正相关。结论：本研究在理解TR TIL生物学方面取得了显著进展，并提供了一种快速准确的方法来识别TR CD8 TILs。
